commit_title: Refine blocky Neutral and Hero morphology (0.25.58)
summary: Refine the Neutral Swim and Power hooks using the red-line directions, broaden Power+Swim into a stepped pointed crown, and distinguish all nine Hero/Normal tips, accents and wings. The original head box, face, shared rig, saved identities and existing HeroRun path remain intact.
limitations: Shapes remain authored blocky approximations: the smooth cone, hooks and leaflike tips use a small number of cuboids, with the original head box fixed.

Final focused checks, 305 required dedicated-server tests and all 77 corrected client scenes passed. The earlier broader build retains the two unchanged triangle/trumpet transition failures; it preceded the isolated final cap-depth fix. Final focused/native/client checks were repeated afterward. The journal retains its existing 8/9 paragraph-format failure.
Current production development-classpath bytes match the delivered JAR; runClient did not load that archive directly. The selected 593 originals all come from the last corrected successful cohort.

The two silent recordings use accelerated training fixtures at native20TPS and original capture timestamps. Twenty decoded movie frames and selected motion/toy/carry frames were reviewed; full interactive playback and listening were not performed.

Physical phone touch, independent remote multiplayer, shaders/resource packs/full modpacks, every toy/accessory and horizontal elytra/swimming carry transitions remain unverified. Migration uses retained fixtures, including an explicitly synthetic older Hero record, rather than an arbitrary real-user save.
